_comment: HYDRA v2.0 HEDGE head (ETH variant) — CROSS-ASSET blend short. Shorts a diversified blend of OTHER assets (hedgeUniverse minus the thesis coin ETH) — but ONLY the ones in a confirmed 4h downtrend (per-asset: drawdown over stressLookback >= stressDropPct OR 1h breaking down), capitulation-guarded. Vol-parity sized (margin scales inversely with each asset's ATR%, normalized to referenceVolPct, clamped) and sized UP by a thesis-stress multiplier when ETH itself is breaking down. Total hedge margin capped at hedgeMaxTotalPct of equity. Never shorts the thesis coin; never bets against the thesis. Auto-scales: light when little is breaking, heavy in a broad selloff. Pairs with the core + dip thesis-long heads on SEPARATE wallets. Set wallet/strategyId/chatId. Runtime owns position tracking, caps, DSL via runtime-hedge.yaml. Producer launched with HYDRA_LEG=hedge.
_v2_note: v2.0 changed the hedge from a SAME-ASSET stress short on the thesis coin to this CROSS-ASSET blend short. hedgeUniverse is the blend of OTHER assets to short; the producer auto-excludes the thesis coin at runtime. stressDropPct is now the PER-ASSET arming threshold for any name in the blend (not thesis-coin-specific). For a higher-vol thesis you can widen thesisStressFullPct so the multiplier ramps more gradually.
_role_note: HEDGE = the CROSS-ASSET cushion for the ETH thesis. It shorts the broad/high-beta names that are actually breaking down, so it profits in a market selloff that would also hurt ETH — WITHOUT shorting ETH itself. Trend-confirmation means it never bleeds shorting names that are rising, and it auto-scales with how much of the market is breaking. The thesis-stress multiplier adds cover exactly when ETH is also breaking. Sizing is vol-parity; total capped at hedgeMaxTotalPct of equity.
_persona: Cross-asset crisis cushion for a single-coin ETH thesis — short-only, diversified blend of other assets, trend-confirmed, vol-parity sized, thesis-stress-scaled. The hedge head of a Hydra v2.0 single-coin conviction fund.
